source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Service Sheet (Part 2225623, 120 V)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Prepare for L–H ohms
steps.body: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Mold heater attached to support; power off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Mold heater attached to support; power off.

steps.title: Mold heater resistance (L–H)
steps.body: 185 W @ 120 V = 72 Ω at L–H with heater on support, blades in park.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 185 W @ 120 V = 72 Ω at L–H with heater on support, blades in park.

steps.title: Live heater voltage (L–H)
steps.body: Restore power and initiate cycle electrically. L–H line voltage = heater ON; 0 V = OFF.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power and initiate cycle electrically. L–H line voltage = heater ON; 0 V = OFF.

steps.title: Heater energizes during harvest?
steps.body: During harvest heat phase, does L–H show line voltage?
steps.sourceExcerpt: During harvest heat phase, does L–H show line voltage?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Heater ohms OK but no L–H voltage — module control or bimetal path.

steps.title: Replace mold heater / module
steps.oemOutcome: Open or out-of-spec L–H heater — replace module (IME3/E3 heater timeout).

steps.title: Module control fault
steps.oemOutcome: Heater element OK but no harvest heat — check bimetal T–H and module.

steps.title: Mold heater verified
steps.oemOutcome: L–H 72 Ω and harvest heater voltage verified.
